raw.description: 每次在场自身的首次使用的攻击技能必定打出致命一击，在打出之前每回合战斗阶段结束时消除对手能力提升状态，消除成功则消除对手回合类效果|战斗阶段结束时，若本次在场自身打出致命一击的次数高于对手则将对手所处的异常状态转化为1回合焚烬，若低于对手则恢复双方最大体力差值的体力，若等于对手则下回合所有技能先制+1|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]每次在场自身的[color=#52a5f2]首次[/color]使用的攻击技能必定打出[color=#52a5f2]致命一击[/color]，在打出之前每回合[color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]消除对手能力提升状态，消除成功则消除对手[color=#52a5f2]回合类效果[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，若本次在场自身打出[color=#52a5f2]致命一击[/color]的次数高于对手则将对手所处的异常状态[color=#52a5f2][color=#52a5f2]转化[/color][/color]为1回合[color=#57c975]焚烬[/color]，若低于对手则恢复双方最大体力差值的体力，若等于对手则下回合所有[color=#52a5f2]技能先制[/color]+1

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 同次多段与组件暴击按已答整次用招最多一次；两版真实参数和当前在场全部比较分支保留。
review.singleBehavior: 首次真实攻击必暴、打出暴击前清强成功清回合；双方致命计数按完整用招各最多一次，含命中零红；比较次数转换异常、按最大HP差魂回复或授下回先制，真实换宠生命周期另延期。
review.deferredBehavior: 实际换入换出后的本次在场首次攻击使用机会、首次打出状态及双方暴击次数统计生命周期。当前多段统计歧义不属于队伍延期。
review.trigger: 每次在场自身首次使用攻击技能；战斗阶段结束比较本次在场致命一击次数

success.name: 4908真实2095首次实际攻击必暴且只一次，普通属性和药剂不消费，控制未用保留机会
success.assertion: test('4908真实2095首次实际攻击必暴且只一次，普通属性和药剂不消费，控制未用保留机会',()=>{const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364]});turn(s,20030);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstAttackUsed,false);turn(s,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstAttackUsed,false);s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=s.round;turn(s,10086);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstAttackUsed,false);turn(s,10086);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,true);turn(s,10086);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.events.length,1);});

success.name: 4908真实2095首次攻击MISS属于首次使用但未打出暴击，后续无强制暴击，打出之前真实清强且成功才清回合
success.assertion: test('4908真实2095首次攻击MISS属于首次使用但未打出暴击，后续无强制暴击，打出之前真实清强且成功才清回合',()=>{const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,hit:false});timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstAttackUsed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['概率闪避'],undefined);turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,0);const p=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true});p.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;timer(p,1,'强化保护');timer(p,1,'probeflag');turn(p,20030,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,2);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].effects.probeflag);const done=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true});turn(done);done.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;timer(done,1,'probeflag');turn(done,10086,20309);assert.equal(done.fighters[1].stages.atk,2);assert.ok(done.fighters[1].effects.probeflag);});

success.name: 4908真实2095双方单次暴击累计高于转换全部异常指定1或2回合，不凭空附加，无异常不触发
success.assertion: test('4908真实2095双方单次暴击累计高于转换全部异常指定1或2回合，不凭空附加，无异常不触发',()=>{for(const has of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true});if(has){s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=4;s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=5;}let state;watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0)state=structuredClone(c.t.ailments);},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(state['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(state['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(state['焚烬'],has?(id===2107?2:1):undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.foeCrit,0);}});

success.name: 4908真实2095低于按双方实际最大体力差魂印回复、技能禁疗不封锁，等于下回全部技能先制原1强化3且不永久残留
success.assertion: test('4908真实2095低于按双方实际最大体力差魂印回复、技能禁疗不封锁，等于下回全部技能先制原1强化3且不永久残留',()=>{const s=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:7000},hp:1000});timer(s,1,'必定暴击');timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');let delta;watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0)delta=c.a.hp;},()=>turn(s,20030,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(delta,3000-sum(s,'attack',1));const p=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true,loadout:[20030,10086,29362,38411,29364]});turn(p);turn(p,10086);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,id===2107?3:1);turn(p,20030);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);});

success.name: 4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP
success.assertion: test('4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364]});const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));}return x;}};try{turn(p);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(p.round,2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(p.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,2);});

success.name: 4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计
success.assertion: test('4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计',()=>{for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,0,'必定暴击');timer(s,1,'必定暴击');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine,replayed=new Set();E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed.has(0)){replayed.add(0);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(38411)));}if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed.has(1)){replayed.add(1);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return x;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(st.events.length,2);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length>=3);if(immune)assert.equal(sum(s),0);else assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38411)],s.moveDefinitions[key(38411)].pp);}

boundary.name: 4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP
boundary.assertion: test('4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364]});const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));}return x;}};try{turn(p);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(p.round,2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(p.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,2);});

boundary.name: 4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计
boundary.assertion: test('4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计',()=>{for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,0,'必定暴击');timer(s,1,'必定暴击');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine,replayed=new Set();E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed.has(0)){replayed.add(0);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(38411)));}if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed.has(1)){replayed.add(1);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return x;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(st.events.length,2);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length>=3);if(immune)assert.equal(sum(s),0);else assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38411)],s.moveDefinitions[key(38411)].pp);}

success.assertion: test('4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计',()=>{for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,0,'必定暴击');timer(s,1,'必定暴击');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine,replayed=new Set();E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed.has(0)){replayed.add(0);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(38411)));}if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed.has(1)){replayed.add(1);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return x;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(st.events.length,2);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length>=3);if(immune)assert.equal(sum(s),0);else assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38411)],s.moveDefinitions[key(38411)].pp);}

interaction.assertion: test('4908真实2107低于按双方实际最大体力差魂印回复、技能禁疗不封锁，等于下回全部技能先制原1强化3且不永久残留',()=>{const s=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:7000},hp:1000});timer(s,1,'必定暴击');timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');let delta;watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0)delta=c.a.hp;},()=>turn(s,20030,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(delta,3000-sum(s,'attack',1));const p=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true,loadout:[20030,10086,29362,38411,29364]});turn(p);turn(p,10086);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,id===2107?3:1);turn(p,20030);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);});

interaction.name: 4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP
interaction.assertion: test('4908已命中零红暴击真实计次，同次两个组件暴击只计一次且不额外扣PP',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364]});const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let replayed=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed){replayed=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));}return x;}};try{turn(p);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(p.round,2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(p.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,2);});

interaction.name: 4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计
interaction.assertion: test('4908已答两版整次用招暴击最多一次：原生多段及同异组件重放均不重计，敌方同次暴击同样去重，命中零红仍计',()=>{for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364],enemyLoadout:[10713,10127,10716,20309,37911]});if(immune)timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,0,'必定暴击');timer(s,1,'必定暴击');const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine,replayed=new Set();E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&!replayed.has(0)){replayed.add(0);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(38411)));}if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&!replayed.has(1)){replayed.add(1);c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));}return x;}};try{turn(s,10086,10713);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,1);assert.equal(st.events.length,2);assert.ok(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length>=3);if(immune)assert.equal(sum(s),0);else assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38411)],s.moveDefinitions[key(38411)].pp);}

success.name: 4908/12两招10%烧伤真实成功失败和次数免疫，40仅先手技能威力双倍
success.assertion: test('4908/12两招10%烧伤真实成功失败和次数免疫，40仅先手技能威力双倍',()=>{for(const move of[11960,11963]){const seen=new Set();for(let n=1;n<=40;n++){const seed=Math.imul(n,2654435761)>>>0,s=make({move,seed});turn(s,move,20309);const yes=!!s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'];seen.add(yes);if(yes){const p=make({move,seed});p.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(p,move,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}for(const late of[false,true]){const a=make({move:11167,aStats:{spe:late?50:500}}),b=make({move:11167,index:-1,aStats:{spe:late?50:500}});let power;watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309));turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);if(late)assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));else assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);}});

success.name: 4908/12两招10%烧伤真实成功失败和次数免疫，40仅先手技能威力双倍
success.assertion: test('4908/12两招10%烧伤真实成功失败和次数免疫，40仅先手技能威力双倍',()=>{for(const move of[11960,11963]){const seen=new Set();for(let n=1;n<=40;n++){const seed=Math.imul(n,2654435761)>>>0,s=make({move,seed});turn(s,move,20309);const yes=!!s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'];seen.add(yes);if(yes){const p=make({move,seed});p.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(p,move,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}for(const late of[false,true]){const a=make({move:11167,aStats:{spe:late?50:500}}),b=make({move:11167,index:-1,aStats:{spe:late?50:500}});let power;watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309));turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);if(late)assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));else assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);}});

success.name: 4908/2007四回合当次用招半体技能回复，回末有强化才固定吸取400并给敌400同源盾，免伤/溢出/禁疗独立
success.assertion: test('4908/2007四回合当次用招半体技能回复，回末有强化才固定吸取400并给敌400同源盾，免伤/溢出/禁疗独立',()=>{for(const mode of['boost','none','immune','overkill','ban']){const s=make({...row(2007),hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000,loadout:[29362,20030,29363,38411,29364]});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,mode==='none'?20309:20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='none'||mode==='immune'?0:400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:mode==='none'?5500:5900);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,mode==='none'?0:400);if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);if(mode==='boost'){turn(s,20030,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}}});

success.name: 4908/2007已授半体回复以实际用招触发，MISS与整招无效仍回复，控制未用及药剂不触发
success.assertion: test('4908/2007已授半体回复以实际用招触发，MISS与整招无效仍回复，控制未用及药剂不触发',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','invalid','miss','control','potion','ban']){const s=make({move:29362,index:2,loadout:[29362,10086,20030,38411,29364],hp:1000});turn(s,29362,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,5500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.heal20074908.length,1);s.fighters[0].hp=1000;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=s.round;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='potion'?1250:['control','ban'].includes(mode)?1000:5500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.heal20074908.length,['control','potion'].includes(mode)?1:2);}});

success.assertion: test('4908/2334打出正红暴击才下两回合免攻、1355次数免异同源刷新1并保留异源2、反弹优先',()=>{for(const id of[2334,1355]){const s=make(row(id));s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;timer(s,0,'必定暴击');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);if(id===2334){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击伤害免疫'].start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击伤害免疫'].end,3);turn(s,s.auditMoveId,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);}else{assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);}}const n=make(row(1355));turn(n,n.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(n.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,0);});

success.assertion: test('4908/2283真实自身盾罩消耗，严格400边界、双方所有源盾罩消除、30%临时上限不回复',()=>{for(const n of[0,400,401]){const s=make(row(2283));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],n,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],600,'enemy');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],400,'enemybar');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000-n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,n>400?0:n);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,n>400?0:600);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,n>400?0:400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,n>400?9420:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel2283.gain,n>400?420:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4908/2283初始封顶4500重复不再增长，不足HP保1且按实际消耗400边界判断',()=>{const s=make(row(2283));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1000,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20000,'enemy');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,13500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);S.refresh(s.fighters[0],1000,'own');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20000,'enemy');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,13500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,7000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);const p=make(row(2283));for(let r=0;r<2;r++){S.refresh(p.fighters[0],600,'own');S.refresh(p.fighters[1],400,'enemy');turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);}assert.equal(p.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9600);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,7800);for(const hp of[1,400,401,600]){const q=make({...row(2283),hp});S.refresh(q.fighters[0],600,'own');turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,1);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].suitState.shield,hp-1>400?0:600);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,hp-1>400?9180:9000);}});

success.name: 4908已答2283初始150%总上限：首次使用前其他增益占额度，后授与跨回合其他增益也受限，反复叠加不漂移且初始基数独立保存
success.assertion:
test('4908已答2283初始150%总上限：首次使用前其他增益占额度，后授与跨回合其他增益也受限，反复叠加不漂移且初始基数独立保存',()=>{for(const order of['before','after','next-turn']){const s=make({...row(2283),aStats:{maxHp:1000}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel2283.base,1000);if(order==='before')s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp+=200;S.refresh(s.fighters[0],500,'own');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],2000,'enemy');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel2283.gain,order==='before'?300:500);if(order==='next-turn')observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.a.stats.maxHp+=200;},()=>turn(s,null,20309));else s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp+=200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,1500);S.refresh(s.fighters[0],450,'own');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel2283.base,1000);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>=1);}
 const untouched=make({move:10086,aStats:{maxHp:1000}});untouched.fighters[0].stats.maxHp+=700;assert.equal(untouched.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,1700);
